answer: Sybil resistance can come from a comet-style entry burn: every new identity must pass through a verifiable proof-of-work gauntlet, shedding compute the way a comet sheds ice in the sun, so spawning ten thousand puppets costs ten thousand burns. Its standing then accrues only through attested work, like a knoll built stone by stone, which no puppet can shortcut. Identities sharing the same operator fingerprints get grouped and down-weighted, so a karst of hidden cavities under one farm collapses into a single low-weight cluster instead of multiplying votes.
